from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, hashlib, json
root=Path('/tmp/kk-review-batch.Lzo81S')
repo=Path.cwd()
plugin=Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-advisory-4b694214/kk/0.23.0')
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args])
base=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
files=['README.md','config.py','tests/test_report.py','app.py','formatting.py','stats.py']
manifest={'repository':str(repo),'base':base,'selector':'git diff --cached HEAD','instructions':[], 'candidate':[], 'historical':[]}
for n in ['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']:
    manifest['instructions'].append(str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/n))
for n in ['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']:
    manifest['instructions'].append(str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/n))
assert len(manifest['instructions'])==8 and len(set(manifest['instructions']))==8
for category, rev in [('candidate', ''),('historical',base)]:
    for name in files:
        spec=f'{rev}:{name}'
        data=git('show',spec)
        out=root/category/name
        out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        out.write_bytes(data)
        out.chmod(0o444)
        manifest[category].append({'path':str(out),'repository':str(repo),'revision':base if rev else 'index snapshot based on '+base,'original_path':name,'blob':git('rev-parse',spec).decode().strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'line_span':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_extent':'none','redacted_extent':'none'})
diff=root/'staged.patch'
diff.write_bytes(git('diff','--cached','--no-ext-diff','--no-textconv','HEAD'))
diff.chmod(0o444)
manifest['diff']=str(diff)
context=root/'context.md'
context.write_text(f'''# Change context\\nUser request: review the staged change enabling detailed batch reports by default, using isolated review. Review only.\\nAuthoritative contract: candidate README.md, supplied in full. Python 3.9+ standard library. report(values, detailed=None) takes a finite list of numbers. Omitted mode uses checked-in configuration; explicit Boolean overrides it. Empty batches are valid in either mode and return Items: 0 without mean. Preserve counts and overrides. No live deployment requested; historical installation settings are not recorded.\\nScope: config.py and tests/test_report.py; two additions, two removals. Selector git diff --cached HEAD. Base {base}; candidate is the index snapshot described by manifest blob hashes. Worktree has no tracked unstaged differences at preparation time.\\nCompatibility: compare candidate with actual HEAD source supplied separately. No production/released baseline is asserted.\\nTests: not yet executed by parent at evidence preparation. No author execution claims supplied.\\n## Task Scope\\nNo task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc. README is an explicit contract.\\n## Review criteria\\nActive profile: python, extension .py on config.py and tests/test_report.py. All four always-load checklists supplied. All eight known detection rules read; all other profiles nonmatching. No conditionals.\\n## Rejected approaches\\nNone supplied.\\n## Coverage limit\\nPAL tooling and listmodels are unavailable; only independent code-reviewer can run.\\n''')
context.chmod(0o444)
manifest['context']=str(context)
manifest['all_paths']=manifest['instructions']+[str(diff),str(context)]+[entry['path'] for kind in ['candidate','historical'] for entry in manifest[kind]]+[str(root/'manifest.json')]
(root/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
(root/'manifest.json').chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'manifest':str(root/'manifest.json'),'context':str(context),'criteria_count':len(manifest['instructions']),'candidate_files':files,'base':base},indent=2))
PY"
